cypher.query: MERGE (p:Part:MANUFACTURING {id: $part_id}) MERGE (proc:Procedure:MANUFACTURING {id: $proc_node_id}) SET proc.procedure_id = $proc_id MERGE (p)-[:REQUIRES_PROCEDURE]->(proc) MERGE (s:ManufacturingStep:MANUFACTURING {id: $step_node_id}) SET s.step_id = $step_id, s.raw_text = $instruction_text, s.action = $action, s.is_value_added = $is_value_added, s.is_safety_critical = $is_safety_critical, s.process_category = $process_category, s.justification = $justification, s.estimated_duration_minutes = $duration, s.military_and_industry_standards = $standards, s.internal_part_numbers = $parts, s.material_and_hardware_slang = $slang MERGE (proc)-[:CONTAINS_STEP]->(s) WITH s UNWIND $standards AS std_name MERGE (std:Standard:MANUFACTURING {id: "std_" + std_name}) SET std.name = std_name MERGE (s)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(std) WITH s UNWIND $parts AS pn MERGE (part:Part:MANUFACTURING {id: "part_" + pn}) SET part.part_number = pn MERGE (s)-[:REQUIRES_PART]->(part) WITH s UNWIND $tools AS t_name MERGE (tool:Tool:MANUFACTURING {id: "tool_" + t_name}) SET tool.part_number = t_name MERGE (s)-[:REQUIRES_TOOL]->(tool) WITH s UNWIND $slang AS term MERGE (st:SlangTerm:MANUFACTURING {id: "slang_" + term}) SET st.term = term MERGE (s)-[:USABLE_SLANG]->(st) MERGE (h:Hazard:MANUFACTURING {id: $hazard_id}) SET h.class = $hazard MERGE (s)-[:HAS_HAZARD]->(h) MERGE (c:Certification:MANUFACTURING {id: $cert_id}) SET c.certification = $cert MERGE (s)-[:REQUIRES_CERT]->(c) WITH s UNWIND $figures AS fig_ref MERGE (f:Figure:MANUFACTURING {id: "fig_" + fig_ref}) ON CREATE SET f.url = $image_prefix + fig_ref + ".png", f.title = fig_ref MERGE (s)-[:REFERENCES_FIGURE]->(f)

MERGE (p:Part:MANUFACTURING {id: $part_id}) MERGE (proc:Procedure:MANUFACTURING {id: $proc_node_id}) SET proc.procedure_id = $proc_id MERGE (p)-[:REQUIRES_PROCEDURE]->(proc) MERGE (s:ManufacturingStep:MANUFACTURING {id: $step_node_id}) SET s.step_id = $step_id, s.raw_text = $instruction_text, s.action = $action, s.is_value_added = $is_value_added, s.is_safety_critical = $is_safety_critical, s.process_category = $process_category, s.justification = $justification, s.estimated_duration_minutes = $duration, s.military_and_industry_standards = $standards, s.internal_part_numbers = $parts, s.material_and_hardware_slang = $slang MERGE (proc)-[:CONTAINS_STEP]->(s) WITH s UNWIND $standards AS std_name MERGE (std:Standard:MANUFACTURING {id: "std_" + std_name}) SET std.name = std_name MERGE (s)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(std) WITH s UNWIND $parts AS pn MERGE (part:Part:MANUFACTURING {id: "part_" + pn}) SET part.part_number = pn MERGE (s)-[:REQUIRES_PART]->(part) WITH s UNWIND $tools AS t_name MERGE (tool:Tool:MANUFACTURING {id: "tool_" + t_name}) SET tool.part_number = t_name MERGE (s)-[:REQUIRES_TOOL]->(tool) WITH s UNWIND $slang AS term MERGE (st:SlangTerm:MANUFACTURING {id: "slang_" + term}) SET st.term = term MERGE (s)-[:USABLE_SLANG]->(st)
